title: Study of prevalence and risk factors of chemotherapy-induced mucositis in gastrointestinal cancer using machine learning models.
summary: The cohort analysis reported toxicity-prediction performance and patient factors associated with mucositis.
ai_technology: Machine-learning models predicted chemotherapy-induced mucositis and ranked associated risk features in gastrointestinal-cancer patients.
